FLASHSCORE PREVIEW

Westerlo face RAAL La Louviere at Het Kuipje in round 13 of the Jupiler Pro League. The odds bookmakers offered on this match give Westerlo a 48% win probability, compared with 26% for RAAL La Louviere.

Current Form - Westerlo

Westerlo are ninth on 14 points after 12 matches, with a record of four wins, two draws and six losses and a 26-31 goal record. Their recent five-match record is one win, one draw and three losses, while their last league match ended in a 0-1 loss to Cercle Brugge. Westerlo are without a win in four matches. Their expected goals stand at 1.5 per match against a league average of 1.6, while their expected goals conceded are 2.04 against the 1.6 average.

Current Form - RAAL La Louviere

RAAL La Louviere sit 17th on seven points after 12 matches, having won two, drawn one and lost nine, with 13 goals scored and 27 conceded. Their last five matches brought one win and four losses, including a 0-3 defeat by Genk in their last league match. RAAL La Louviere have lost six away matches from home. Their expected goals are 1.34 per match against a league average of 1.6, and their expected goals conceded are 2.05 against the 1.6 average.

Head-to-Head Record

Westerlo were unbeaten in their last two meetings against RAAL La Louviere, one win and one draw. Last season, Westerlo beat RAAL La Louviere 2-1, with Westerlo at home.

Westerlo vs RAAL La Louviere
Flashscore
Key Players to Watch

Norman Bassette is Westerlo’s top scorer with eight goals as a forward, while Cisse Sandra has two goals and two assists as a midfielder. Nikola Storm has two goals in five games as a forward. Dylan Ourega, who has one goal and one assist, is a doubt for this match with a thigh injury.

Mustapha Isah leads RAAL La Louviere with six goals as a forward. Wagane Faye has one assist in 10 games as a defender, while Leandro Rousseau has two goals in nine games as a forward; all of Rousseau’s goals came in his last five matches.

➖ Expected goals conceded (xGA): 2.05 per match (2nd worst, league average 1.60)

➖ Errors leading to goal: 6 (most in the league, league average 1.7)

Match Notes

Westerlo’s Pape Diong received one red card in the last 10 matches, two matches ago. RAAL La Louviere’s Yllan Okou has collected four yellow cards in six appearances.

Betting Insights

The over/under line is 2.5 goals, with a 56% probability for over 2.5. Both teams to score is priced at a 58% probability for “yes”.
